item.title: Zbur Introduces Bill to Strengthen Protections for Youth in Foster Care
item.description: California Assemblymember Rick Chavez Zbur introduces AB 1967 to strengthen protections for youth in foster care ages 18-21 and require 21-day review of abuse reports.

item.title: Malibu Council Takes First Step to Speed Rebuilding for Palisades Fire Victims
item.description: Malibu City Council votes 5-0 to streamline seawall variances for 320+ beachfront properties damaged in Palisades Fire, allowing faster rebuilding.

item.title: At SoFi Stadium, Australia Maps the Next Decade of Global Sports Tourism
item.description: Tourism Australia executives met at SoFi Stadium to map global sports tourism strategy linking 2026 FIFA World Cup, LA28 Olympics, and Brisbane 2032.

item.title: Palisades Recovery Becomes a Test of Leadership, Insurance, and Accountability
item.description: San Jose Mayor Matt Mahan tours Pacific Palisades burn zone with Rick Caruso, discussing insurance barriers and infrastructure needs for California fire recovery.

item.title: New study lays out trade-offs as Santa Monica school district weighs artificial turf decisions
item.description: Santa Monica-Malibu school district study finds artificial turf saves 20 million gallons of water annually but raises chemical exposure concerns.

item.title: Viola Floral Opens New Studio with Community Event
item.description: Viola Floral hosts open studio event March 5, 3:30-5:30pm at 916 Colorado Ave, Santa Monica. Features spring flowers, workshops, and new Viola Flower School launch.

item.title: Film Screening to Spotlight Western Monarch Butterfly Conservation
item.description: Watch 'Western Monarch Butterflies: Protecting Our Pollinators' at Peter Strauss Ranch Friday 5-7:30pm. $15 tickets support conservation efforts.

item.title: Women-Owned Businesses Take Center Stage at Makers Hive Market
item.description: Makers Hive Market returns to Santa Monica Place March 8, featuring women-owned businesses in fashion, art, wellness and food for Women's History Month.

item.title: Rooftop Tesla Cybertruck catches fire
item.description: The Santa Monica Fire Department responded to a vehicle fire on the rooftop of a parking structure near Olympic/Cloverfield on Wednesday afternoon. The investigation into the fire was ongoing at the time of publication but smoke and flames could be seen from several nearby buildings.
